meta.sources: Sleeper projections + ADP, FantasyPros ECR (9/08), FFC ADP (12-team half-PPR, 9/3-9/8, 1,837 drafts), nflverse 2025

room.name: Kejjeh (you)
room.td: 2023 champ. Value drafter (avg 5 picks later than market).

room.name: sallymcbride
room.td: Josh Allen threat at 23: took him at 29 last year, QB by R3-4 both years. WR-WR to open. TE R6-7. 2024 champ. Has never made a waiver claim.

room.name: bogeman
room.td: QB R3-4 (Hurts at 36 last year), TE late. Most active manager: 36 waiver claims, $285 FAAB, 3 trades. 4-10 then 7-7.

room.name: MaxSchussler
room.td: TE early: round 4 each of the last two years (Kittle at 40), 18 picks ahead of market. QB late. RB-RB to open in 2023-24.

room.name: LaisterSmith
room.td: One season. WR R1, QB R3 (Daniels at 35), TE R9. Most rookie-heavy drafter (20% of picks).

room.name: mikedonutgang200
room.td: Defending champ, 12-2, 125 PPG. WR in R1 every year, QB R3-4 (9 picks early), TE R5-7. Never uses waivers.

room.name: clyvejohnson
room.td: RB in R1 every year, then QB R4-6 (Burrow at 43), TE R7-9. Drafts at market, never uses waivers. 10-4 last year.

room.name: chaguy2457
room.td: Biggest Bowers threat: took him at 21 (R2, 13 picks early) last year. Waits on QB (R11). 9-5, spent his full $100 FAAB.

room.name: glavoile
room.td: TE in R3 two years running (McBride at 26). WR in R1 every year. QB 12 picks early. Reach-prone. 3-11 last year.

room.name: reijcage
room.td: WR-WR to open, QB late (R4-6, 10 picks after market), TE R7-8. Best PPG in league history (123). 10-4 in 2024.

room.name: pbrady98
room.td: RB in R1 every year (Saquon 1.01 last year). TE R5-7 but 16 picks early (LaPorta R5). Takes two QBs by R10. Reach-prone. 5-9.

room.name: SirChadius
room.td: Was coochiemoocher22. Biggest reacher in the league (Pitts at 70, 84 picks early; TE in R2 in 2023). QB late. Active: 32 claims, $153 FAAB.

players.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
players.note: Consensus 1.01 everywhere. Montgomery gone to HOU, backup Pacheco on IR. 25.1 PPG in the 6 games without Montgomery last year.

players.name: Bijan Robinson
players.note: 1.02 by every source. Only knock: 6.5-win Falcons offense; Tua is the ATL starter with Penix out for W1.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.note: Age 30, 413 touches in 2025, calf tightness = rep management. Plays W1 in Australia. Draft as normal; hold his handcuff.

players.name: Ja'Marr Chase
players.note: Knee hyperextension late Aug, back at practice, W1 expected. TD regression is baked into the projection.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Psoas/core in camp; full speed, no setbacks. Plays Thu in Australia vs SF.

players.name: Jonathan Taylor
players.note: Daniel Jones back from Achilles and starting; JT's ceiling rides on him. Floor still elite (double-digit TDs every full year).

players.name: James Cook
players.note: Top-5 RB price; TD-dependent (11 projected).

players.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
players.note: 35.8% target share in 2025. Sleeper ADP 8.8 vs FFC 5.9.

players.name: Chase Brown
players.note: Sleeper ADP 17 vs FFC 13.6 / ECR 15.

players.name: De'Von Achane
players.note: Malik Willis is now the MIA QB (Tua to ATL). Rebuild offense, but he IS the offense.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Age 29, 2025 was a down year (13.2 PPG). Sleeper ADP 10.6 vs ECR 16.

players.name: Derrick Henry
players.note: Age 32. ECR 20 but Sleeper drafters take him at 14. Justice Hill / Rasheen Ali behind him, healthy.

players.name: Kenneth Walker
players.note: Now a Chief. Foot soreness was shoe-related; W1 ready. RBs slide in this room: reaches 24 in 35% of history-aware sims (ADP alone said 4%). Top target at the turn.

players.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
players.note: Gibbs stack partner; steady.

players.name: Omarion Hampton
players.note: Broke an ankle W5 last year, back. Keaton Mitchell change-of-pace only. Reaches 24 in ~27% of history-aware sims.

players.name: Nico Collins
players.note: 12.6 PPG in 15 games last year; Sleeper projects 218. Reaches 24 ~41%, 25 ~29%: the WR to take at the turn.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.note: Low-ankle sprain, questionable but tracking to play W1 with managed snaps. Reaches 24 in ~32% of history-aware sims; buy the dip.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Elite TE1 by 11 pts over McBride. But THIS ROOM takes TEs early: chaguy2457 (pick 17) took him at 21 last year, glavoile (16) took McBride at 26, MaxSchussler (21) goes TE in R4, SirChadius/pbrady reach for TEs. Gone before 24 in ~all history-aware sims. Only a bonus if he falls.

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: Now a Cowboy. Reaches 24 ~65%, 25 ~63% in the history-aware sims.

players.name: Javonte Williams
players.note: 14.1 PPG in 2025 for DAL. Sleeper ADP 31, FFC 28.5.

players.name: Trey McBride
players.note: TE2. glavoile (pick 16) took him in R3 two years running. Also gone before 24 in the history-aware sims.

players.name: Josh Allen
players.note: QB1 by 20 pts. sallymcbride picks 23 and took him at 29 last year; mikedonutgang and glavoile take QBs 9-12 picks early. At 24 only ~22%. QB4-QB12 sit within 15 pts, so wait.

players.name: Chris Olave
players.note: Healthy. Jordyn Tyson (rookie 1st-rounder) on IR 4-8 wks, so Olave is the only target hog in NO.

players.name: Kyren Williams
players.note: Rams plan close to 50/50 with Corum. Fade at his round-3 price; Corum is the value.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.note: Groin strain mid-Aug; moving well, expected to start W1. Any discount is a buy.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.note: ACL Oct 2025; game-time decision W1 vs DAL. ECR 28 with a huge spread (9-47). Expect a slow ramp.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Rookie, ARI. High-ankle sprain; 50/50 for W1 and easing back. Bad OL. Sleeper ADP 27.8.

players.name: D'Andre Swift
players.note: Bears RB1. Left practice with 'a cramp'; Monangai wk-to-wk (knee). Roschon Johnson trending. Value if he slides past 48.

players.name: Travis Etienne
players.note: Now in NO. Kamara (knee) not ready, so Etienne opens as the lead back.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Now a Texan. Available at 48 about 47%. Goal-line role in a real offense.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.note: No suspension (Rapoport, Aug 12). Offseason knee surgery + a jail stint. Top-12 upside, real risk. Sleeper ADP 29, FFC 18.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.note: Toe sprain (not turf toe); expected W1. Godwin is the pivot if he sits.

players.name: Colston Loveland
players.note: Year-2 Bears TE, TE3 by projection; ECR sd 12 (experts split).

players.name: Bucky Irving
players.note: TB lead back; ADP 46.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.note: Sleeper drafters take him at 35 (ECR 54). Early-down role with Tracy/Singletary on passing downs. Overpriced at ADP; fine at 48+.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.note: CLE lead back, year 2. Available at 48 about 73%.

players.name: Luther Burden
players.note: Grade-1 groin, cleared. Bears WR with Loveland/Odunze; ECR 49, Sleeper ADP 59. The sim's favorite at pick 49.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: Age 30. Available at 48 about 83%.

players.name: Jameson Williams
players.note: Boom/bust WR2 in DET. FFC 37, Sleeper 57.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: QB2. ECR 38, Sleeper ADP 34, FFC 56 - the sources disagree.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.note: Available at 48 about 97%. GB WR1 role.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Now a 49er, age 33. Two quad injuries + groin in camp; questionable but expected Thu. Sleeper proj 185 vs ECR-implied 162.

players.name: Rome Odunze
players.note: Right leg, sat Mon, precautionary.

players.name: Tyler Warren
players.note: Groin was minor; unrestricted.

players.name: Parker Washington
players.note: JAX starter in 11 and 12 personnel; targets over Thomas per camp.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Age 33, LAR. ADP falling.

players.name: Jadarian Price
players.note: SEA 1st-round rookie; Charbonnet on PUP (ACL) until at least W5. Clear RB1 for a month-plus.

players.name: Sam LaPorta
players.note: Hip; back at practice, snap count managed W1.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: JAX; questionable tag on Sleeper.

players.name: Tucker Kraft
players.note: ACL cleared, no restrictions; Jonnu Smith signed behind him.

players.name: Brian Thomas
players.note: WR3 in JAX 2-WR sets behind Meyers and Washington; comes off for Hunter packages. Talent bet only.

players.name: Marvin Harrison
players.note: Year 3, ARI. ECR 73.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: QB4; available at 72 about 37%.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: NE lead back while Henderson (ankle) is out.

players.name: Jayden Daniels
players.note: QB6 by projection; available at 72 about 63%.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: Out since Aug 24 (ankle); unlikely W1 (Wed game). Upside stash at a discount.

players.name: George Kittle
players.note: Achilles (Jan). Off PUP, playing W1 with limited snaps. Age 32.

players.name: Trevor Lawrence
players.note: QB7; available at 72 about 99%, at 96 about 73%. The QB the sim actually lands.

players.name: Caleb Williams
players.note: QB8; available at 72 about 90%.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.note: Two ACLs; CAR 'very optimistic'. ADP 88, sleeper appeal.

players.name: MarShawn Lloyd
players.note: GB RB1 while Jacobs sits on the exempt list (two misdemeanors pending). ADP jumped 66 spots in a week. The sim's favorite at 96/97.

players.name: Chuba Hubbard
players.note: Hamstring in Aug; full go for W1.

players.name: Blake Corum
players.note: Rams moving toward 50/50; RB36 PPG from W7 on last year. Value at ADP about 100.

players.name: Patrick Mahomes
players.note: ACL/LCL Dec 2025. Full participant since July, says on track for W1. QB15 price; run-heavy plan early.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Hyperextended knee; wk-to-wk, maybe W2.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: Named MIN starter over McCarthy; Jefferson's QB.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: MIA starter on a 3-yr, $67.5M deal.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: NO rookie WR; short-term IR, 4-8 weeks. Do not draft.

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.note: Back at practice Mon after 6 missed; change-of-pace behind Hampton.

players.name: Devaughn Vele
players.note: NO WR2 while Tyson is on IR; streamer.

players.name: Daniel Jones
players.note: IND starter, back from Achilles.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Commissioner's exempt list; cannot practice or play until resolved. Late stash only.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Knee; not ready. Etienne leads NO.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.note: HOU: Jayden Higgins tore an ACL (out for the year). Dell trending up.

players.name: Isiah Pacheco
players.note: DET, on IR. Do not draft.

players.name: Justice Hill
players.note: Henry's backup, healthy.
